meta.description: ACCEPTANCE, two-enemy combination (?polyp=2): the polyp locks the post-mid lane and the judged hound-rejoin beat prices the drop reroute directly beneath it — dodging the beam now lands the bot in a charging hound's patrol. Same fully closed-loop skeleton as polyp-lane-dodge (zero timed inputs: bunny-hop off each actual landing while x<52.8, air-jump on each falling edge inside the chimney shaft x 38-47 below roof height, pinned-recovery as backstop; then funnel into the lane while the iris is quiet, drop through on polypTell, re-mount between volleys, vault out after 10.5s), plus the proven policy-hound-reactive answer: tap jump whenever a hound telegraphs. The run demonstrates the vertical stack: polyp cycles above, hound tells/charges below, and the bot has to answer BOTH with movement verbs on the same decision point. Expected (measured 3/3 across closed-loop tuning runs) VICTORY with kills 0, two hits — both are the stack itself pricing the answer: the hound-tell jump lifts the bot into the band at the moment fire begins, the squeeze working in the other direction; hp and hull-fallback setbacks are reported honestly (the stack is allowed to cost — that is what it is for; at 1 hp a bulb contact triggers the slice's own HULL FALLBACK mercy, which restores hp, dislodges a route down and counts a setback). With no timed inputs left there is no arrival-time fork for dispatch quantization to compound through; the old ~1-in-7 approach jam is gone with the timed hops that caused it. The regression signals are a stall, or the hound/polyp never both engaging in the trace.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against a hardcoded fixture snapshot, radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README

rules.when: airborne && vy<0 && x>38 && x<47 && y<10 && gameMs<10500
